'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Brian Terwilliger DS Wookiee Slaving Operation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Terwilliger]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Wookiee Slaving Operation / Indentured To The Empire]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
